chunks: Some people attribute this and the previous saying to the Messenger of Allāh (may Allāh bless him and his descendants).

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الرِّضِيُّ: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī, the compiler/editor of Nahj al-Balagha
key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: May Allāh bless him and his family

ai.seo_question: Who attributes this saying to the Messenger of Allāh according to As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Raḍī highlights the scholarly practice of distinguishing between the Prophet’s direct words and the Imam’s interpretations, noting that some attribute this specific saying to the Messenger of Allāh (peace be upon him and his family). This observation underscores the nuanced transmission of wisdom in Nahj al-Balagha, where the boundary between Prophetic tradition and Imam Ali’s exposition often blurs in the eyes of early narrators. It reflects the broader Shia emphasis on the continuity of divine guidance through both the Prophet and the Imams.
